set.body:
Migrated from canardlapin/scalafim Mote bd-01KY3J2WABXY3ZM1K87J8BK363 on 2026-08-01 after HalfFlow ownership moved to canardlapin/reframe4s.
Source status: open. Source created_at: 2026-07-22T00:02:23.691588Z.

Only after local-engine failure analysis, evaluate cosine-windowed FFT proposals and optional learned affine/features behind Proposal. The hrf-private FFT is not reusable; add a Gale FFT capability only with a general contract and at least one second consumer. Every proposal must pass the same objective, inverse, and topology gates and must report a no-proposal ablation.
set.title: HalfFlow X: optional FFT and learned coarse proposals
